subject: Reconcile third-party roster + clarification on EU data transfers
messages:
From: Lena Zhou <security@finoptics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@finoptics.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Third-party roster reconciliation and EU transfer question

Hi Marissa,

FinOptics is wrapping up our annual vendor compliance review and we need an up-to-date copy of Redwood's third-party processing roster for any partners that could access or process EU personal data for our account (FinOptics). Specifically: 

- A CSV export of the current roster (names, roles, country of processing, contractual DPA status)
- A simple dataflow diagram showing where customer request payloads and telemetry may traverse across providers
- Any subprocessors added in the last 90 days and whether they perform cross-border transfers out of the EU

Our internal deadline is Friday (Nov 20). If there are any known temporary telemetry/observability vendors that route data to the US (even if only logs/metrics), please flag them and indicate whether we can request onshore routing for our tenant.

Also, if there are DPA addenda or attestations we should expect to sign, please point me to the correct DocuSign or contract owner.

Thanks — appreciate a short confirmation that you received this and an estimated ETA.

Best,
Lena Zhou
Head of Security Operations
FinOptics, Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lena Zhou <security@finoptics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Third-party roster reconciliation and EU transfer question

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 09:12 AM Lena Zhou <security@finoptics.com> wrote:
> FinOptics is wrapping up our annual vendor compliance review and we need an up-to-date copy of Redwood's third-party processing roster...

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up. We're on it.

Quick plan:
- Kimberly (privacy & compliance) will produce the roster CSV and the dataflow diagram and attach the snapshots.
- Jordan (ops) will validate whether any on-tenant telemetry is routed to US-only partners for FinOptics and note mitigations.
- I'll coordinate DocuSign for any DPA addenda if needed.

Could you confirm whether your scope includes "telemetry only" (logs/metrics) or also full request payloads (request/response)? That will help us prioritize.

We expect to share a first-pass package by EOD Wednesday (Nov 18). If you need an interim call, I can set one up tomorrow morning.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Trust & Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Lena Zhou <security@finoptics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Third-party roster reconciliation and EU transfer question

Hi Lena / Marissa — attaching the inventory you requested.

Attachment stubs: roster_snapshot_20261116.csv (CSV) | dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf (PDF)

Summary notes (high level):
- The attached CSV contains current subprocessors, their primary function, processing country, and DPA status for tenant-scoped processing.
- Additions in the last 90 days: EdgeSight (telemetry/observability) — processes aggregated telemetry and application metrics; primary processing cluster for EdgeSight is in the US.
- EdgeSight does NOT persist unredacted customer request payloads by default; they collect anonymized metrics and application traces. However, some debug dumps (rare) can include request IDs and truncated snippets — we classify these as "limited payload exposure".
- Mitigation options available for FinOptics: enable regional-only routing for telemetry, or onshore routing via our temporary bridge while contractual addendum is executed.

Jordan: confirmed that for FinOptics tenant we can enable regional routing immediately (config change) — will need to coordinate a short maintenance window (<30 mins).

I will also attach a short onshore_routing_playbook.txt with steps and a note about retention settings.

If you need a breakdown of which telemetry fields EdgeSight collects (field-level), let me know and I'll pull a redacted schema.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

From: Lena Zhou <security@finoptics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@finoptics.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Third-party roster reconciliation and EU transfer question

Thanks Kim — the package is helpful. A few clarifying Qs: 

1) For EdgeSight, does "limited payload exposure" include customer PII in any circumstance? If so, what fields and under what retention window?
2) For the onshore routing option: will that ensure telemetry and any debug dumps remain in EU-only infrastructure (no replication to US)? We will need an attestation that no automatic replication occurs while the addendum is in negotiation.
3) Contracts: please route the DPA addendum to contracts@finoptics.com and copy our legal contact Emma Park (emma.park@finoptics.com). We usually need a short summary of the change (one paragraph) for our legal intake.

If you can answer 1–2 by end of day Thursday (Nov 19) we can accept the temporary routing while we process the paperwork. Otherwise we may request a short scheduled maintenance to disable the telemetry pipeline.

Best,
Lena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lena Zhou <security@finoptics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@finoptics.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Third-party roster reconciliation and EU transfer question

Hi Lena — thanks for the questions. Quick responses and next steps: 

1) EdgeSight payload exposure: we do not capture customer PII as a policy. The "limited payload exposure" refers to rare debug artifacts that may include truncated identifiers (e.g., request_id, user_id hash) but not cleartext PII fields. I asked our engineering team to prepare a redacted field-level schema; Kimberly will send that by EOD tomorrow.

2) Onshore routing: Jordan confirmed we can flip FinOptics tenant to EU-only telemetry routing immediately and that no automatic replication to the US will occur while that flag is set. We'll provide an attestation statement (short PDF) once routing is enabled. Estimated lead time: 2 hours to schedule and execute with minimal impact.

3) Contracts: Marissa to own DocuSign routing. Marissa has opened a DPA addendum draft and will send to contracts@finoptics.com and Emma Park (cc) for review — link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/privacy/dpa-addendum-template

Actions: 
- Jordan to schedule regional-routing change for FinOptics (actioned today).
- Kimberly to send detailed telemetry field schema (redacted) by EOD Fri (Nov 20).
- Marissa to route DPA addendum via DocuSign and update HubSpot (FO-2093).

I'll follow up after the routing change and attach the attestation PDF.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Trust & Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
